config.preparation: Use sp500_stocks.csv as the primary panel. Join sp500_companies.csv on Symbol with a many-to-one cardinality check (companies.Symbol unique) and sp500_index.csv on Date with a many-to-one cardinality check (index.Date unique); do not join across symbols. Parse Date and keep rows where Date is Friday. config.rationale: The objective is to rank Friday decision rows by the probability of a future 5% adjusted-close drop, which is a binary classification problem.
